$comment: Drain-side batching controls enqueue cadence without changing GitHub rulesets; precedence per key is env > repo > platform > standard, and invalid values fall through. enabled (standard false, WE_MQ_BATCHING_ENABLED) enables batching, groupSize (3, WE_MQ_BATCHING_GROUP_SIZE) limits groups to 1..5 PRs, groupFormMinutes (5, WE_MQ_BATCHING_GROUP_FORM_MINUTES) closes a group when full or its forming time elapses, and maxGroupsInFlight (1, WE_MQ_BATCHING_MAX_GROUPS_IN_FLIGHT) caps active groups. failureThreshold (3, WE_MQ_BATCHING_FAILURE_THRESHOLD) failures within failureWindowMinutes (120, WE_MQ_BATCHING_FAILURE_WINDOW_MINUTES) trigger strict single-PR groups for strictModeMinutes (60, WE_MQ_BATCHING_STRICT_MODE_MINUTES), while failed groups are isolated one PR at a time to identify culprits. cancelIntermediateRuns (auto, WE_MQ_BATCHING_CANCEL_INTERMEDIATE_RUNS; auto|on|off) cancels intermediate runs automatically only under live HEADGREEN, and rulesetId (24883772, WE_MQ_BATCHING_RULESET_ID) identifies the ruleset for read-only inspection. Repo values: enabled true and groupSize 3 per the operator GO 2026-10-13; maxGroupsInFlight 2 keeps a second group building so a deferred PR does not wait a whole group cycle (replay of 10-12/13: 1.16 vs 1.18 CI runs per merged PR under ALLGREEN).
